title: Record and edit a motion and sound gesture
scenario: Record a two-second gesture, edit its height curve and replay it as motion and sound.
host: Chrome 158 on macOS, desktop and narrow viewports
backend: Moxi Python SVG and Web Audio
fixture: Synthetic flight and authored height gesture
reproduce: Run the recorded-gesture browser check from examples/motion-envelope as described in its README.

slides.caption: The original flight is ready to play at revision zero.
slides.action: Open the motion and sound editor.
slides.expected: The original flight is ready to play at revision zero.

slides.caption: The two-second take records a height curve while the saved flight stays available.
slides.action: Start recording and change Height during the take.
slides.expected: The two-second take records a height curve while the saved flight stays available.

slides.caption: Motion and sound gain follow the edited curve on repeated playback.
slides.action: Edit one point while stopped, then commit the take.
slides.expected: Motion and sound gain follow the edited curve on repeated playback.

slides.caption: The editor restores the preceding take.
slides.action: Start a replacement take and cancel it.
slides.expected: The editor restores the preceding take.

slides.caption: The pending recording can be cancelled.
slides.action: Start recording while audio activation is pending.
slides.expected: The pending recording can be cancelled.

slides.caption: The prior draft survives and the author can retry.
slides.action: Try recording with audio activation unavailable.
slides.expected: The prior draft survives and the author can retry.

slides.caption: The full recorded curve and the 750 ms inspection position return.
slides.action: Save the gesture at 750 ms, commit a different flight, then restore.
slides.expected: The full recorded curve and the 750 ms inspection position return.
